topics.title: A Bottle of Dew: the story and its events
topics.ncert_sections: A Bottle of Dew: Let us read I and II

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the main events of 'A Bottle of Dew' and put them in the correct order.
Explain what sage Mahipati asked Rama Natha to do and the real purpose behind the task.

topics.title: A Bottle of Dew: characters and message
topics.ncert_sections: A Bottle of Dew: Let us read II; Let us think and reflect

concepts.learning_objective: State the message of the story that wealth is created by hard work, not by magic.
Describe the qualities of Rama Natha, Madhumati and sage Mahipati from what they say and do.

topics.title: A Bottle of Dew: words, homophones and connecting words
topics.ncert_sections: A Bottle of Dew: Let us learn

concepts.learning_objective: Give the meanings of words and phrases from the story such as tended, give up and precious.
Identify homophones such as dew-due and son-sun and use them correctly in sentences.
Join ideas with suitable connecting words such as because, before and as soon as.

topics.title: The Raven and the Fox: the poem and its lesson
topics.ncert_sections: The Raven and the Fox: Let us read; Let us think and reflect

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the characters and events of the poem 'The Raven and the Fox' by Jean de La Fontaine.
Explain how the Fox used flattery and the Raven's pride, and the lesson the poem teaches.

topics.title: The Raven and the Fox: rhyme, alliteration and vocabulary
topics.ncert_sections: The Raven and the Fox: Let us learn

concepts.learning_objective: Identify rhyming words and the rhyme pattern of the stanzas of the poem.
Recognise alliteration as the repetition of the same consonant sound at the start of nearby words.
Give the meanings and opposites of words from the poem such as limb, perched and pride.

topics.title: Rama to the Rescue: the story
topics.ncert_sections: Rama to the Rescue: Let us read; Let us think and reflect

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the characters, problem and events of the story 'Rama to the Rescue'.
Explain how the couple used a clever plan and presence of mind to get help from the kotwal.

topics.title: Contractions and the present progressive tense
topics.ncert_sections: Rama to the Rescue: Let us learn I-IV

concepts.learning_objective: Expand contracted words such as they're, I'm and won't and explain the use of the apostrophe.
Form and use the present progressive tense (am/is/are + verb + ing) for actions happening now.

topics.title: Adverbs, exclamatory and interrogative sentences
topics.ncert_sections: Rama to the Rescue: Let us learn VI-X

concepts.learning_objective: Identify adverbs that tell how an action is done and choose suitable adverbs for sentences.
Distinguish exclamatory and interrogative sentences and punctuate them correctly.
